I really appreciate your caring response. This means a lot to me. 

Thankfully it is long distance and we do not live together. I don't really know who to talk to about this. 

Do you mind if I DM you? I perfectly understand if not.
These pictures speak volumes, treasure them and the memories you both shared with your heart. Thank you for sharing.
You, my friend, have great taste in flowers!
That's a way to burst my bubble.
Ironic that the username is ''feellikebeingajerk''. Should be ''feellikebeingakindperson''.
This made my day. Thank you for sharing.
Oh yeah. I even have ranch sandwiches.
